text:
anya: Hey — console is showing a different project for a SA key than the routing logs show. Not sure if this is a telemetry tagging bug or routing fallback.

sam: Hmm. Seen this before. Likely the exchange path sets X-Origin-Project after auth proxy, but console reads the initial claim. Order mismatch.

joel: Can you paste the request headers from the trace? I suspect header precedence is flipped in the proxy.

anya: infra-bot attached trace:
infra-bot: TRACE 2025-05-14T16:03Z request_id=abc123 headers={"X-Org": "org-42", "X-Origin-Project": "proj-99", "X-Exchange-Project": "proj-77"} route=auth-proxy -> router -> serving

sam: Yep. Router uses X-Exchange-Project when present, console telemetry was reading X-Origin-Project. So dashboard shows the wrong billing/project attribution.

joel: Two risks: 1) quota enforcement might block wrong project; 2) billing/console shows wrong owner. We should fix telemetry read order and add a fallback metric.

maya: From product: we need a UX that shows both 'reported origin' and 'effective project' during rollout, and an explicit migration flag so admins know when attribution flips.

devon: For quotas, change is sensitive. If effective project differs, we should continue enforcing on the effective project but log the reported origin until rollout completes.

sam: Proposed fix:
```diff
- telemetry_project = headers.get('X-Origin-Project')
+ telemetry_project = headers.get('X-Exchange-Project') or headers.get('X-Origin-Project')
```
Also augment traces with tag "project_resolution_path": "exchange->router->effective" when we pick X-Exchange-Project.

joel: Add a metric `project_attribution_mismatch` and sample 1% of full payloads for manual replay. That will catch edgecases without PII exposure.

anya: Can someone pick up the console change? Minimal UI shows both fields and a tooltip explaining precedence. Also need a migration playbook for SRE/Support.

maya: I'll draft the tooltip copy and migration note in the console docs.

devon: Who will own the rollout flag? We need a feature flag in infra with an audit log entry when flipped.

sam: I'll open a PR for the header precedence + trace tag. Tagging @joel for the metric and sampling. I'll gate with a feature flag `resolve_project_from_exchange` default false.

joel: I'll add the metric and a Grafana panel. Also wire an alert when mismatch rate > 0.5% per minute.

anya: Thanks. Action items: sam PR, joel metrics + panel, maya docs + UI tweak, devon feature flag + audit. ETA preliminary changes by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-canary started for pr#4521

sam: FYI I'll include a unit test for precedence and an integration test exercising real exchange headers. 

anya: Great. Keep updates here. If anyone spots customer-facing anomalies, ping support + billing asap.
